verdict.rationale: dlt's core pipeline model processes data in bulk by design: full-load replaces entire datasets, incremental/merge loading upserts or deduplicates large batches of records via merge_key/primary_key, and backfill/refresh operations let agents reprocess many items across runs. Deployment and orchestration features (dlthub deploy, schedule/backfill/chain pipelines) extend this to bulk operations across multiple pipelines. missing for 10: explicit benchmarks or hands-on evidence of bulk operations at very large scale, and independent (non-vendor) confirmation of bulk/backfill behavior.
